notes: PASS on all 20 frozen steps on the core-only M2M OAuth path; Enterprise Agent accounts were not used.
Provider/application M2M semantics satisfy the fixture, but the path is less direct than ZITADEL/Keycloak service-identity primitives for this specific lane.
Token revocation was introspected active→inactive; provider deletion denied the old client; replacement provider/app/token succeeded; outage failed closed.
Internal-only LAB network, no host ports, no production credentials or raw token/secret material.
Three-component tested topology: authentik server, worker and PostgreSQL.
Observed wall/startup were 84/71 seconds; terminal snapshots were about 471 MiB server, 390 MiB worker and 91 MiB PostgreSQL.
Core-only boundary is acceptable, but this is the broadest measured runtime surface of the identity challengers.
Complete 20-step receipt includes token introspection before/after revoke, provider deletion, replacement identity and outage proof.
Resource values are terminal snapshots rather than sampled peaks.
Immutable server/PostgreSQL pins and teardown were proven in LAB.
Persistent promotion requires database backup/restore and server/worker version-coupling drill.

security_findings: Token revocation, provider deletion and outage fail-closed all passed.
